title: P1 enqueue: response
description: TaskRef{id, existing}: existing: true means that the key already existed for the same initiator with the same body and the existing task is returned (IDM-1). A denial is problem details with a reason from the registry; a permission denial carries needs, a ceiling denial retry_after_s. idempotency_conflict comes without an id. The branch with reason in the success body is deprecated: in the HTTP v1 binding an enqueue denial always comes as problem details with status 422 (spec/bindings/http/README.md); the branch remains until 1.0 only for form compatibility.
